## Objective
- Update HELIX to begin at the cellular stage, show stage-appropriate details for the selected creature, and add a DNA bank for saving and browsing genomes.
- Preserve playability and ground evolution in real genome and molecular research.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them upon completion.
- For visual checks, save a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Represent cellular-stage organisms as cells with a membrane, nucleus, nucleolus, mitochondria, and ribosomes.

## Work State
### Completed
- `Creature` accepts a `stage` option and selects `buildCell()` for cellular organisms.
- `index.html` has the DNA bank header button `#btn-dna-bank`.
- Inspected relevant source code, HTML, and styling to resume implementation.

### Active
- Pass stage through population spawning/replacement; initialize and reset in cellular stage.
- Add cellular-safe animation and transition to later evolution stages.
- Update selected-specimen dossier details and labels for the current stage.
- Implement DNA bank modal, genome persistence/browsing, and interactions.
- Build and run the game, verify behavior, and inspect the latest compliant JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add stage state and pass it through `CreatureSystem.spawnPopulation()` and `replace()`; initialize and reset in cellular stage.
2. Add cellular-safe animation and transition to later evolution stages.
3. Update dossier details and labels for the selected stage.
4. Implement DNA bank modal and event handlers.
5. Build, run, verify behavior, and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot (maximum width 1280px).
6. Summarize implementation choices and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Startup/reset, evolution, dossier rendering, event handlers, state, and DNA bank integration.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, cellular representation, animation, and population spawning.
- `index.html`: UI shell; includes `#btn-dna-bank`, but no bank modal markup yet.
- `src/style.css`: Modal and application styling.
- `src/genetics.js`: Genome structure, mutation, and population evolution.
- `package.json`: Build and run scripts.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `index.html` was already user-modified, and `src/creature.js` contains prior assistant edits.
- `Creature.build()` selects `buildCell()` when `this.stage === "cellular"`, but stage is not passed by population spawning or set at startup/reset.
- `CreatureSystem.spawnPopulation(population, positions)` and `replace(index, organism)` construct creatures without passing a stage.
- `Creature.update(dt)` runs animal-specific movement and part animation; add a separate cellular animation path before those routines.
- `advanceGeneration()` respawns the population, while `resetStudy()` and `initialize()` also spawn it; all need cellular-stage initialization or stage propagation.
- `updateSelectionUI()` currently displays animal-centric details; stage-specific presentation remains to be implemented.
- DNA bank button exists, but `index.html` contains only help-modal markup.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Update HELIX to begin at the cellular stage, show stage-appropriate details for the selected creature, and add a DNA bank for saving and browsing genomes.
- Preserve playability and ground evolution in real genome and molecular research.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them upon completion.
- For visual checks, save a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Represent cellular-stage organisms as cells with a membrane, nucleus, nucleolus, mitochondria, and ribosomes.

## Work State
### Completed
- `Creature` accepts a `stage` option, and `build()` selects `buildCell()` for cellular organisms.
- `index.html` has the DNA bank header button `#btn-dna-bank`.

### Active
- Pass stage through population spawning/replacement; initialize and reset in cellular stage.
- Add cellular-safe animation and transition to later evolution stages.
- Update selected-specimen dossier details and labels for the current stage.
- Implement DNA bank modal, genome persistence/browsing, and interactions.
- Build and run the game, verify behavior, and inspect the latest compliant JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add stage state and pass it through `CreatureSystem.spawnPopulation()` and `replace()`; initialize and reset in cellular stage.
2. Add cellular-safe animation and transition to later evolution stages.
3. Update dossier details and labels for the selected stage.
4. Implement DNA bank modal and event handlers.
5. Build, run, verify behavior, and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot (maximum width 1280px).
6. Summarize implementation choices and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Startup/reset, evolution, dossier rendering, event handlers, state, and DNA bank integration.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, cellular representation, animation, and population spawning.
- `index.html`: UI shell; includes `#btn-dna-bank`, but no bank modal markup yet.
- `src/style.css`: Modal and application styling.
- `src/genetics.js`: Genome structure, mutation, and population evolution.
- `package.json`: Build and run scripts.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `index.html` was already user-modified, and `src/creature.js` contains prior assistant edits.
- `Creature.build()` handles cellular appearance, but stage is not passed by population spawning or set at startup/reset.
- `CreatureSystem.spawnPopulation(population, positions)` and `replace(index, organism)` construct creatures without passing a stage.
- `Creature.update(dt)` runs animal-specific movement and part animation; add a separate cellular animation path before those routines.
- `advanceGeneration()`, `resetStudy()`, and `initialize()` all spawn the population and need cellular-stage initialization or stage propagation.
- `updateSelectionUI()` currently displays animal-centric details; stage-specific presentation remains to be implemented.
- DNA bank button exists, but `index.html` contains only help-modal markup.

## Objective
- Update HELIX to begin at the cellular stage, show stage-appropriate details for the selected creature, and add a DNA bank for saving and browsing genomes.
- Preserve playability and ground evolution in real genome and molecular research.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them upon completion.
- For visual checks, save a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Represent cellular-stage organisms as cells with a membrane, nucleus, nucleolus, mitochondria, and ribosomes.

## Work State
### Completed
- `Creature` supports a `stage` option and builds cellular organisms with `buildCell()`.
- `index.html` has the DNA bank header button `#btn-dna-bank`.
- Added cellular-safe animation in `Creature.update(dt)` for cell bobbing, rotation, nucleus pulsing, and organelle movement.

### Active
- Pass stage through population spawning/replacement; initialize and reset in cellular stage.
- Add a transition from cellular organisms to later evolution stages.
- Update selected-specimen dossier details and labels for the current stage.
- Implement DNA bank modal, genome persistence/browsing, and interactions.
- Build and run the game, verify behavior, and inspect the latest compliant JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add stage state and pass it through `CreatureSystem.spawnPopulation()` and `replace()`; initialize and reset in cellular stage.
2. Implement progression from cellular to later stages.
3. Update dossier details and labels for the selected stage.
4. Implement DNA bank modal and event handlers.
5. Build, run, verify behavior, and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot (maximum width 1280px).
6. Summarize implementation choices and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Startup/reset, evolution, dossier rendering, event handlers, state, and DNA bank integration.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, cellular representation and animation, and population spawning.
- `index.html`: UI shell; includes `#btn-dna-bank`, but no bank modal markup yet.
- `src/style.css`: Modal and application styling.
- `src/genetics.js`: Genome structure, mutation, and population evolution.
- `package.json`: Build and run scripts.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `index.html` was already user-modified, and `src/creature.js` contains earlier edits.
- `CreatureSystem.spawnPopulation(population, positions)` and `replace(index, organism)` still construct creatures without passing a stage.
- `advanceGeneration()`, `resetStudy()`, and `initialize()` all spawn the population and need cellular-stage initialization or stage propagation.
- `updateSelectionUI()` remains animal-centric; stage-specific presentation is pending.
- The DNA bank button exists, but `index.html` contains only help-modal markup.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Update HELIX to begin at the cellular stage, show stage-appropriate details for the selected creature, and add a DNA bank for saving and browsing genomes.
- Preserve playability and ground evolution in real genome and molecular research.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them upon completion.
- For visual checks, save a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Represent cellular-stage organisms as cells with a membrane, nucleus, nucleolus, mitochondria, and ribosomes.

## Work State
### Completed
- `Creature` supports a `stage` option, builds cellular organisms with `buildCell()`, and has cellular-safe animation in `Creature.update(dt)`.
- `index.html` has the DNA bank header button `#btn-dna-bank`.
- Added `stage: "cellular"` to the simulation state in `src/main.js`.

### Active
- Pass stage through population spawning/replacement; ensure initialization and reset use cellular stage.
- Implement progression from cellular organisms to later evolution stages.
- Update selected-specimen dossier details and labels for the current stage.
- Implement DNA bank modal, genome persistence/browsing, and interactions.
- Build and run the game, verify behavior, and inspect the latest compliant JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add stage propagation to `CreatureSystem.spawnPopulation()` and `replace()`; initialize and reset cellular-stage populations.
2. Implement progression from cellular to later stages.
3. Update dossier details and labels to match the selected stage.
4. Implement the DNA bank modal, persistence, browsing, and event handlers.
5. Build, run, verify behavior, and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot (maximum width 1280px).
6. Summarize implementation choices and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Stage state, startup/reset, evolution, dossier rendering, event handlers, and DNA bank integration.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, cellular representation and animation, and population spawning.
- `index.html`: UI shell; includes `#btn-dna-bank`, but no bank modal markup yet.
- `src/style.css`: Modal and application styling.
- `src/genetics.js`: Genome structure, mutation, and population evolution.
- `package.json`: Build and run scripts.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `index.html` was already user-modified, and `src/creature.js` contains earlier edits.
- `CreatureSystem.spawnPopulation(population, positions)` and `replace(index, organism)` still construct creatures without passing a stage.
- `advanceGeneration()`, `resetStudy()`, and `initialize()` spawn populations and still need stage propagation.
- `updateSelectionUI()` remains animal-centric; stage-specific presentation is pending.
- The DNA bank button exists, but `index.html` contains only help-modal markup.

- Preserve playability and ground evolution in real genome and molecular research.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them upon completion.
- For visual checks, save a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Represent cellular-stage organisms as cells with a membrane, nucleus, nucleolus, mitochondria, and ribosomes.

## Work State
### Completed
- `Creature` supports a `stage` option, builds cellular organisms with `buildCell()`, and has cellular-safe animation in `Creature.update(dt)`.
- Simulation state in `src/main.js` starts at `stage: "cellular"`.
- `index.html` has the DNA bank header button `#btn-dna-bank`.
- Changed `CreatureSystem.spawnPopulation()` to accept an optional `stage = "organism"` argument.

### Active
- Pass `stage` through `CreatureSystem.spawnPopulation()` and `replace()` constructors; ensure initialization and reset use cellular stage.
- Implement progression from cellular to later stages.
- Update selected-specimen dossier details and labels for the current stage.
- Implement the DNA bank modal, genome persistence/browsing, and event handlers.
- Build and run the game, verify behavior, and inspect the latest compliant JPEG screenshot.

- (none)

1. Pass the stage argument into constructed creatures in `spawnPopulation()` and `replace()` in `src/creature.js`.
2. Update `src/main.js` population spawn calls for initialization, reset, and generation advance; implement cellular-to-organism progression.
3. Add stage-appropriate dossier labels/details.
4. Add DNA bank modal markup, persistence/browsing, and handlers.
5. Build, run, verify behavior, and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot (maximum width 1280px).

- `src/style.css`: Modal and application styling.
- `src/genetics.js`: Genome structure, mutation, and population evolution.
- `package.json`: Build and run scripts.

- `updateSelectionUI()` remains animal-centric; stage-specific presentation is pending.
